title: Occupancy and Residency Certification: Completion of an Annual Certification Cycle
content:
A certification cycle on an Occupancy and Residency Certification profile is completed once the plan's required signatures are recorded under the cycle's certification year. This entry governs the date the completed cycle is recorded as certified; when a cycle counts as complete (the plan's required signatures recorded under the cycle's certification year) and the return of a pending or overdue profile to current remain as the product's rules on certifications provide.

## Dates on completion

When a cycle completes, the last certified date becomes the cycle's completion date under this rule and the due date moves forward by the plan's certification interval in months to the next closing anniversary.

## Condition on the profile

> A cycle's completion date is fixed only after every accepted certification form on file for the cycle stands on the profile as a recorded certification.

Restated in the same form: as long as any accepted certification form on file for the cycle has no recorded certification on the profile, the cycle's completion date is not fixed.

## What completion records

The servicing agent marks the profile's open certification cycle as complete:

1. the profile's last certification date becomes the date given;
2. its due date moves forward to the next anniversary of the monitored loan's closing date that falls after the current due date;
3. a profile that was pending its first certification or overdue becomes current.

Nothing else on the profile changes.

## Invocation

`complete_certification_cycle_e152f965` is an agent-side tool; the servicing agent unlocks it and calls it with two parameters:

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `residency_profile_id` | reference number of the occupancy certification profile whose open cycle is completed, as returned by the occupancy profile lookup for the borrower | identifier |
| `last_certified_date` | the date the completed cycle is recorded as certified | calendar date written YYYY-MM-DD; never empty |

## Receipt

One line of the form "Cycle completed on profile <profile reference>: certified <last certified date>, next due <new due date YYYY-MM-DD>, status <status>." Its presence, rather than a line beginning "Error", means the profile now carries that last certification date, due date and status, as the profile lookup then shows.
